sanskrit: sa jayati śiva ekaḥ spandavānsvapratiṣṭhaḥ yo'ntarvaktraṃ rasayati jayatyeṣa vīraḥ kulendraḥ
l1:
## sand-p01 (1)
He / is-victorious / Śiva / alone / possessing-spanda / self-established / who / inner-face / makes-taste / is-victorious / this / hero / lord-of-the-Kula // sand-p01
l2:
He alone — Śiva, possessing spanda, self-established — who makes the inner face taste.

This hero, lord of the Kula — victorious.
l3:
He alone conquers — Śiva, throbbing, self-established — who savors the inner face.
Victorious is this hero, the Kula’s lord.
